info.title: Testmo Universal API
info.description: Manage Testmo projects, users, milestones, test runs, sessions, automation runs, cases, folders, and related QA workflows through the Testmo REST API.

put.description: Marks an automation run as completed in Testmo.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

automationRunId.description: ID of the automation run to complete.

measureElapsed.description: Whether Testmo should compute elapsed time from run creation to completion.
